score41_rule_base: Workout days build up to 100 points. Each week starts on Sunday.
score41_rule_bonus: +5 per new PR set (up to +10), +2 per protein-goal day (up to +6), and +5 for a workout day beyond your target.
score41_rule_tie: Bonuses add up to +20 (120 total). Ties go to whoever reached the score earlier, then username.
